mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_detail ( company_name, company_addr, company_field, company_license, company_as, company_career, company_intro) VALUES ( #{companyName}, #{companyAddr}, #{companyField}, #{companyLicense}, #{companyAs}, #{companyCareer}, #{companyIntro} )
INSERT INTO company ( user_id, company_detail_id, location_id) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{companyDetailId}, #{locationId} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, cd.company_name AS companyName, cs.avg_total_rate AS companyRate, cs.company_review_count AS reviewCount, CONCAT(f.file_path, '/', f.file_name) AS thumbnailPath FROM company_detail cd JOIN company c ON cd.company_detail_id = c.company_detail_id LEFT JOIN company_score_avg cs ON c.company_id = cs.company_id JOIN file f ON f.target_id = c.company_id AND f.target_type = 'INTERIOR' WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, d.company_addr AS companyAddr, d.company_field AS companyField, d.company_license AS companyLicense, d.company_as AS companyAs, d.company_career AS companyCareer FROM company c JOIN company_detail d ON c.company_detail_id = d.company_detail_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.is_deleted = false

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, d.company_name AS companyName, d.company_intro AS companyIntro, d.company_addr AS companyAddr, d.company_license AS companyLicense, d.company_field AS companyField, s.avg_total_rate AS companyRate FROM company c JOIN company_detail d ON c.company_detail_id = d.company_detail_id LEFT JOIN company_score_avg s ON c.company_id = s.company_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.is_deleted = false
SELECT file_id, file_uploader, file_name, file_path, target_type, target_id FROM file WHERE target_type = #{target_type} AND target_id = #{target_id}
SELECT company_id FROM company WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, cd.company_detail_id AS companyDetailId, cd.company_name AS companyName, cd.company_Addr AS companyAddr, cd.company_field AS companyField, cd.company_License AS companyLicense, cd.company_as AS companyAS, cd.company_career AS companyCareer, cd.company_intro AS companyIntro FROM company_detail cd JOIN company c ON cd.company_detail_id = c.company_detail_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE company_detail SET company_name = #{companyName}, company_addr = #{companyAddr}, company_field = #{companyField}, company_license = #{companyLicense}, company_as = #{companyAs}, company_career = #{companyCareer}, company_intro = #{companyIntro} WHERE company_detail_id = #{companyDetailId}

UPDATE location SET location_addr = #{locationAddr}, location_lat = #{locationLat}, location_lng = #{locationLng}, location_ac = #{locationAc}, location_limit = #{locationLimit} WHERE location_id = #{locationId}
